    frpm."County Name" AS County,
    frpm."School Name" AS SchoolName,
    frpm."Charter School (Y/N)" AS CharterStatus,
    frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS Enrollment,
    frpm."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS FreeMealPercentage,

    frpm

    schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode

    satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE 
    schools.Virtual = 'F' 
    AND frpm."County Name" IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara');

    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,

    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,

SELECT 
    c.bond_id,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    b.bond_type,
    CASE
        WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    m.label AS molecule_label
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

SELECT 
    c.bond_id,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    b.bond_type,
    CASE
        WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    m.label AS molecule_label
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

SELECT 
    c.bond_id,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    b.bond_type,
    CASE
        WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'

    m.label AS molecule_label
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id

JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

sql:
SELECT 
    c.bond_id,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    b.bond_type,
    CASE
        WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    m.label AS molecule_label
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

sql:
SELECT 
    c.bond_id,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    b.bond_type,
    CASE
        WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    m.label AS molecule_label
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    b.bond_type,
    CASE
        WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    m.label AS molecule_label,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    b.bond_type,
    CASE
        WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'

    m.label AS molecule_label,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count,

FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    b.bond_type,
    CASE
        WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    m.label AS molecule_label,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

WITH state_members AS (
    SELECT 
        zip_code.state, 
        COUNT(*) AS total_members
    FROM 
        member
    JOIN

    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,

JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,

    m.label AS molecule_label,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count,

JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

WITH state_members AS (
    SELECT 
        zip_code.state, 
        COUNT(*) AS total_members
    FROM 
        member
    JOIN 
        zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code
    WHERE 
        member.position = 'Member'
    GROUP BY 
        zip_code.state
),
total_members AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(total_members) AS total
    FROM 
        state_members
),
percentages AS (
    SELECT 
        state, 
        (total_members * 100.0 / total) AS percentage_of_members
    FROM 
        state_members
    JOIN 
        total_members
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT percentage_of_members FROM percentages WHERE state = 'New Jersey') - 
    (SELECT percentage_of_members FROM percentages WHERE state = 'Vermont') AS percentage_difference;

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    b.bond_type,
    CASE
        WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    m.label AS molecule_label,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

sql:
SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    b.bond_type,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    CASE
        WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    m.label AS molecule_label,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

sql:
WITH state_members AS (
    SELECT 
        zip_code.state, 
        COUNT(*) AS total_members
    FROM 
        member
    JOIN 
        zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code
    WHERE 
        member.position = 'Member'
    GROUP BY 
        zip_code.state
),
total_members AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(total_members) AS total
    FROM 
        state_members
)
SELECT 
    sm.state, 
    sm.total_members,
    (sm.total_members * 100.0 / tm.total) AS percentage_of_members
FROM 
    state_members sm
JOIN 
    total_members tm;

JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id

sql:
WITH state_members AS (
    SELECT 
        zip_code.state, 
        COUNT(*) AS total_members
    FROM 
        member
    JOIN 
        zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code
    WHERE 
        member.position = 'Member'
    GROUP BY 
        zip_code.state
),
total_members AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(total_members) AS total
    FROM 
        state_members
)
SELECT 
    sm.state, 
    sm.total_members,
    (sm.total_members * 100.0 / tm.total) AS percentage_of_members
FROM 
    state_members sm
JOIN 
    total_members tm;
exec_sql:

        zip_code.state, 
        COUNT(*) AS total_members
    FROM 
        member

    WHERE 
        member.position = 'Member'
    GROUP BY 
        zip_code.state
),
total_members AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(total_members) AS total
    FROM 
        state_members
)
SELECT 
    sm.state,

sql:
SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    b.bond_type,
    CASE
        WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    m.label AS molecule_label,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

sql:
SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    b.bond_type,
    CASE
        WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    m.label AS molecule_label,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

SELECT 
    bond_id,
    atom1_id,
    atom1_element,
    atom2_id,
    atom2_element,
    bond_type,
    bond_classification,
    molecule_label,
    atom_count,
    bond_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        b.bond_id,
        c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
        a1.element AS atom1_element,
        c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
        a2.element AS atom2_element,
        b.bond_type,
        CASE
            WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
            WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
            ELSE 'Other Bond Type'

        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count

    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2'
)
ORDER BY bond_id;

WITH state_members AS (
    SELECT 
        zip_code.state, 
        COUNT(*) AS total_members
    FROM 
        member
    JOIN 
        zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code
    WHERE 
        member.position = 'Member'
    GROUP BY 
        zip_code.state
),
total_members AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(total_members) AS total
    FROM 
        state_members
),
percentages AS (
    SELECT 
        state, 
        (total_members * 100.0 / total) AS percentage_of_members
    FROM 
        state_members
    JOIN 
        total_members
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT percentage_of_members FROM percentages WHERE state = 'New Jersey') - 
    (SELECT percentage_of_members FROM percentages WHERE state = 'Vermont') AS percentage_difference;

sql:
SELECT 
    bond_id,
    atom1_id,
    atom1_element,
    atom2_id,
    atom2_element,
    bond_type,
    bond_classification,
    molecule_label,
    atom_count,
    bond_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        b.bond_id,
        c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
        a1.element AS atom1_element,
        c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
        a2.element AS atom2_element,
        b.bond_type,
        CASE
            WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
            WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
            ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
        END AS bond_classification,
        m.label AS molecule_label,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count
    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2'
)
ORDER BY bond_id;

WITH state_members AS (
    SELECT 
        zip_code.state, 
        COUNT(*) AS total_members
    FROM 
        member
    JOIN 
        zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code
    WHERE 
        member.position = 'Member'
    GROUP BY 
        zip_code.state
),
total_members AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(total_members) AS total
    FROM 
        state_members
),
percentages AS (

    FROM 
        state_members
    JOIN 
        total_members
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT percentage_of_members FROM percentages WHERE state = 'New Jersey') - 
    (SELECT percentage_of_members FROM percentages WHERE state = 'Vermont') AS percentage_difference;

SELECT 
    bond_id,
    atom1_id,
    atom1_element,
    atom2_id,
    atom2_element,
    bond_type,
    bond_classification,
    molecule_label,
    atom_count,
    bond_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        b.bond_id,
        c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
        a1.element AS atom1_element,
        c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
        a2.element AS atom2_element,
        b.bond_type,

            WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
            WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'

    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2'
)
ORDER BY bond_id;

SELECT

    atom1_id,
    atom1_element,

    bond_type,

    molecule_label,
    atom_count,
    bond_count

        a1.element AS atom1_element,

            WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'

        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count

    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2'

SELECT 
    bond_id,
    atom1_id,
    atom1_element,
    atom2_id,
    atom2_element,
    bond_type,
    bond_classification,
    molecule_label,
    atom_count,
    bond_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        b.bond_id,
        c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
        a1.element AS atom1_element,
        c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
        a2.element AS atom2_element,
        b.bond_type,
        CASE
            WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
            WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
            ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
        END AS bond_classification,
        m.label AS molecule_label,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count
    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2'
)
ORDER BY bond_id;

sql:
WITH state_members AS (
    SELECT 
        zip_code.state, 
        COUNT(*) AS total_members
    FROM 
        member
    JOIN 
        zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code
    WHERE 
        member.position = 'Member'
    GROUP BY 
        zip_code.state
),
total_members AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(total_members) AS total
    FROM 
        state_members
)
SELECT 
    sm.state, 
    sm.total_members,
    (sm.total_members * 100.0 / tm.total) AS percentage_of_members
FROM 
    state_members sm
JOIN 
    total_members tm;

    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id

    JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2'
)
ORDER BY bond_id;

WITH state_members AS (
    SELECT 
        zip_code.state, 
        COUNT(*) AS total_members
    FROM 
        member
    JOIN 
        zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code
    WHERE

    FROM 
        state_members

    sm.state, 
    sm.total_members,
    (sm.total_members * 100.0 / tm.total) AS percentage_of_members
FROM 
    state_members sm
JOIN

sql:
SELECT 
    bond_id,
    atom1_id,
    atom1_element,
    atom2_id,
    atom2_element,
    bond_type,
    bond_classification,
    molecule_label,
    atom_count,
    bond_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        b.bond_id,
        c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
        a1.element AS atom1_element,
        c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
        a2.element AS atom2_element,
        b.bond_type,
        CASE
            WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
            WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
            ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
        END AS bond_classification,
        m.label AS molecule_label,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count
    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2'
)
ORDER BY bond_id;

SELECT 
    bond_id,
    atom1_id,
    atom1_element,
    atom2_id,
    atom2_element,
    bond_type,
    bond_classification,
    molecule_label,
    atom_count,
    bond_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        b.bond_id,
        c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
        a1.element AS atom1_element,
        c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
        a2.element AS atom2_element,
        b.bond_type,
        CASE
            WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
            WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
            ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
        END AS bond_classification,
        m.label AS molecule_label,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count
    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2'
)
ORDER BY bond_id;

WITH state_members AS (
    SELECT 
        zip_code.state, 
        COUNT(*) AS total_members
    FROM 
        member
    JOIN 
        zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code
    WHERE 
        member.position = 'Member'
    GROUP BY 
        zip_code.state
),
total_members AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(total_members) AS total
    FROM 
        state_members
),
percentages AS (

    FROM 
        state_members
    JOIN 
        total_members
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT percentage_of_members FROM percentages WHERE state = 'New Jersey') - 
    (SELECT percentage_of_members FROM percentages WHERE state = 'Vermont') AS percentage_difference;

WITH state_members AS (
    SELECT 
        zip_code.state, 
        COUNT(*) AS total_members
    FROM 
        member
    JOIN 
        zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code
    WHERE 
        member.position = 'Member'
    GROUP BY 
        zip_code.state
),
total_members AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(total_members) AS total
    FROM

percentages AS (

        state_members
    JOIN 
        total_members
)

    (SELECT percentage_of_members FROM percentages WHERE state = 'New Jersey') -

                CAST(SPLIT(SUBSTR(r.time, 2), ':')[0] AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
                CAST(SPLIT(SUBSTR(r.time, 2), ':')[1] AS INTEGER) * 60 +

    b.bond_type,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,

        WHEN a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'

    AVG(
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION(':', r.time) > 1 THEN 
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[0] AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[1] AS INTEGER) * 60 +

                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[0] AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[1] AS INTEGER) * 60
        END
    ) AS average_time_seconds
FROM 
    driverStandings ds
JOIN 
    drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId

SELECT 
    ra.year,
    AVG(
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION(':', r.time) > 1 THEN 
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[0] AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[1] AS INTEGER) * 60 +
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[2] AS INTEGER) +
                CAST(SUBSTR(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), LENGTH(REPLACE(r.time, '+', '')) - 3) AS INTEGER) / 1000
            ELSE 
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[0] AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[1] AS INTEGER) * 60
        END
    ) AS average_time_seconds
FROM 
    driverStandings ds
JOIN 
    drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN 
    results r ON ds.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN 
    races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE 
    ds.position = 1
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL
    AND ra.year < 1975
GROUP BY 
    ra.year;

    SELECT 
        zip_code.state, 
        COUNT(*) AS total_members
    FROM 
        member
    JOIN 
        zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code

total_members AS (

    FROM

    (SELECT (total_members * 100.0 / total_members_total.total) FROM state_members WHERE state = 'Vermont') AS percentage_difference
FROM 
    total_members AS total_members_total;

SELECT 
    AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', c.birth_date, a.date) / 365.25) AS average_age_at_opening,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_with_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN c.client_id END) AS successfully_completed_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN c.client_id END) AS currently_in_debt,
    MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.date)) AS earliest_year,
    MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.date)) AS latest_year
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d2 ON c.district_id = d2.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01' AND d2.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT 
    ra.year,
    AVG(
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION(':', r.time) > 1 THEN 
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[0] AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[1] AS INTEGER) * 60 +
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[2] AS INTEGER) +
                CAST(SUBSTR(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), LENGTH(REPLACE(r.time, '+', '')) - 3) AS INTEGER) / 1000
            ELSE 
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[0] AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[1] AS INTEGER) * 60
        END
    ) AS average_time_seconds
FROM 
    driverStandings ds
JOIN 
    drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN 
    results r ON ds.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN 
    races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE 
    ds.position = 1
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL
    AND ra.year < 1975
GROUP BY 
    ra.year;

    ROUND(AVG(CAST(DATE_DIFF('day', c.birth_date, a.date) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) / 365.25), 2) AS average_age_at_opening,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.loan_id IS NOT NULL THEN c.client_id END) AS total_number_with_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN c.client_id END) AS number_with_successfully_completed_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN c.client_id END) AS number_currently_in_debt,
    MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.date)) AS earliest_year,
    MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.date)) AS latest_year
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN district d2 ON c.district_id = d2.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01' AND d2.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(DATE_DIFF('day', c.birth_date, a.date) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) / 365.25), 2) AS average_age_at_opening,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.loan_id IS NOT NULL THEN c.client_id END) AS total_number_with_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN c.client_id END) AS number_with_successfully_completed_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN c.client_id END) AS number_currently_in_debt,
    MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.date)) AS earliest_year,
    MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.date)) AS latest_year
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN district d2 ON c.district_id = d2.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01' AND d2.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(DATE_DIFF('day', c.birth_date, a.date) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) / 365.25), 2) AS average_age_at_opening,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.loan_id IS NOT NULL THEN c.client_id END) AS total_number_with_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN c.client_id END) AS number_with_successfully_completed_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN c.client_id END) AS number_currently_in_debt,
    MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.date)) AS earliest_year,
    MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.date)) AS latest_year
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN district d2 ON c.district_id = d2.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01' AND d2.A2 = 'Sokolov';
